summary: Pulse Biosciences filed an 8-K announcing an irrevocable election to redeem its outstanding common stock warrants (200% Warrants) issued in a July 2024 rights offering. The warrants are redeemable at $0.01 per underlying share if the VWAP exceeds 200% of the exercise price ($22.00) for 20 consecutive trading days. Holders may exercise for cash until July 13, 2026, before redemption. No premium or board recommendation is noted. Key watch item: warrant holder exercise behavior ahead of the redemption deadline.
